title: Peddler in Another World: I Can Go Back to My World Whenever I Want
titleRomaji: Itsudemo Jitaku ni Kaerareru Ore wa, Isekai de Gyoushounin wo Hajimemashita
titleEnglish: Peddler in Another World: I Can Go Back to My World Whenever I Want
titleNative: いつでも自宅に帰れる俺は、異世界で行商人をはじめました
synopsis: After quitting his job at a toxic company, Shiro Amata moves into the house his grandmother left him in her will. There, he soon makes two life-changing discoveries: one, his grandmother was really a witch from another world, and two, said other world is just on the other side of her closet door! Thanks to a book she left for Shiro, he also manages to obtain an all-powerful skill called “Equivalent Exchange,” which allows him to turn money from his world into otherworldly currency and vice versa. With this, Shiro decides to set up shop and sell convenient items like matches to the colorful inhabitants of the other world. His plan: make a massive profit on the goods he brings from home to become so rich that he never needs another job ever again! Based on the light novel of the same name. (Source: j-novel club)

title: Jeonjik Seongnyeowa Heungmagui Bimil Yeonae
synopsis: Ji-Yeon Kim, a college student on a leave of absence, was living an ordinary life until she found herself possessed into a romance novel her friend had shown her: The Saint's Flower. She became Iola, a girl who appeared halfway through the book. The world of the novel, centered around the saintly heroine and her romantic lead, was not meant for her. Still, she thought that becoming a character in a story might bring her happiness—just like the protagonist of a novel would. But everyone hurled hatred at her. They despised her. They called her Iola, the wicked woman who tormented the heroine—a false saint. But the truth was different. Iola herself was the true saint. Blessed by the divine, she returns to the very beginning. This time, she no longer needs her family, those who hate her, the title of Saint, or even the fiancé she once loved. She will walk a different path than before. "Even if this world tries to turn me into a villainess, I don’t care. I will survive and I will find happiness!" (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

synopsis: My peaceful school life... is officially over. Izumiya Ryouta, an introverted otaku, suddenly finds himself surrounded by the top three beauties of the class after a seat change. In front of him sits the little-sister-type Miyama Airi. To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri. On the surface, they're flawless beauties—but Ryouta stumbles upon secrets that none of them can ever let out... "P-Please...! Just don't tell anyone about this!" "From now on, we're in that kind of relationship." "This is a secret... just between you and me, Ryouta-kun." All he wanted was a quiet otaku life—so how did things end up like this?! Caught between three troublesome girls, an introverted otaku desperately fights to avoid any more chaos in this love-comedy showdown! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Streaming War
titleNative: ストリーミング・ウォー
synopsis: To become a top-notch streamer, a reckless girl named Yoru Kihara, also known as "Angel Hell," earns money through extreme streaming. Thanks to the support of her fans, she managed to save up her target amount to move to the city. However, her abusive parents took everything: her savings and her streaming equipment. In utter despair, Yoru attempts her final act—streaming her own suicide from an abandoned building. But suddenly, she’s attacked by someone wearing a creepy rabbit mask. This marks her fateful encounter with "Streaming War," a grotesque streaming site where underground streamers go to satisfy their insatiable need for recognition!

(Source: Yen Press) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.
